answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 50713 Country: India Title: TAHARAH(Purity) Question: My question is that one night I had ihtilam and I realized this after I had offered Fajr namaz. Would my namaz be accepted as this happened by mistake? Please answer it soon. Answer ID: 50713 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 433/B-89/TB=03/1435) If you found it after offering Fajr salah then your salah was not valid. Hence it is necessary to reoffer it after making ghusl. It is mentioned in Dur al-Mukhtar: وجد في ثوبه منياً أو بولاً أو دماً أعاد من آخر احتلام وبول ورعاف ٍ (الدر المختار ج 1 ص 40 دارالكتاب) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
